_comment: Vault-specific settings for the linking system. Copy this file into another project and edit it; the scripts in scripts/ read it and contain no vault-specific strings. See skills/linking-system/SKILL.md.
_frontmatter_note: stage and category are mandatory and must come first, in that order (true on every note). tag is optional and semantic — it usually mirrors the folder but is allowed to differ where the note's filing intent differs; those cases are listed in tag_overrides.

proposer._exclude_note: LINKING.md section 5: boilerplate profile/database pages carry no transferable mechanism, so they are noise in a proposer. Matched against the wiki-relative path.
proposer._diversity_note: One hub note can otherwise fill the whole list. Cap how often a single note appears in the ranked output.
